description: This file defines the WeeklyTimesheetPeriod class, a subclass of TimesheetPeriod, responsible for handling weekly timesheet periods including calculating dates within the period and setting period details. It is part of the OrangeHRM Time module plugin.

classes.name: WeeklyTimesheetPeriod
classes.description: Manages weekly timesheet periods, including calculating dates within the period and setting period start date. Extends TimesheetPeriod.

methods.name: calculateDaysInTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the dates within the weekly timesheet period based on current date and XML configuration.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriodAndStartDate
methods.description: Returns an XML string representing the timesheet period, with start date and period type.

methods.name: getLocalTimezone
methods.description: Determines the local timezone name based on client's timezone offset.
